title: Analytical Neel Optimality, Zero-Float Thermal PPT-Bound Entanglement Proofs, and Constructive Lean 4.35.0 Formalization for Symmetric XY-Chain Covariance Criteria
abstract: Mathe, Usui, Guhne, and Vitagliano (arXiv:2611.33284v1) derive optimal covariance-matrix-criterion (CMC) structure-factor witnesses for thermal spin-1/2 XY chains, lower-bound the geometric measure of entanglement E_G(rho) via a numerical semidefinite relaxation of a product-state maximization conjecture, and report thermal PPT-bound entanglement in the N=4 periodic XX chain via floating-point diagonalization. We advance their program on three fronts. First (Theorem A), we build a standalone constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel formalizing Observation 1 (arbitrary-N Bloch-sphere spin-squeezing and finite-mixture variance concavity), Theorem 1 (exact 3-variable CMC polyhedron LP optimality and 4-corner attainability), Corollary 1 (exact primal-dual separability equivalence with constructive local-noise decomposition), and Proposition 1 (best-separable-approximation bound). Second (Theorem B), we analytically resolve their Section H Neel-state optimality conjecture at N=4: proving the exact 4-qubit Bloch-vector singlet identity p_0 = (3 - S_2 + Q)/24 <= 1/3 (attained iff Neel), the spin-sector bound 2 p_2 >= p_0, and global secular dominance f_phi(mu) <= f_Neel(mu) for all mu > -lambda > 0. Thus the maximum over product states of lambda_max(lambda W' + |phi><phi|) is exactly the largest root mu_Neel(lambda) of mu^3 - (lambda+1)mu^2 + (lambda - 2 lambda^2)mu + lambda^2 = 0, yielding SDP-free certified analytical E_G(rho) lower bounds. Third (Theorem C), we derive the exact algebraic thermodynamics of the 4-qubit periodic ferromagnetic XX chain via H^5 - 12 H^3 + 32 H = 0, prove identical e^{+2 beta} cancellation in the 3-term CMC threshold, and deliver a zero-float exact rational proof (via LDL^T Cholesky and Gershgorin enclosures of radius < 10^-29, and < 10^-43 at M=22) that all seven partial transposes of rho_beta are strictly positive definite while omega_CMC(rho_beta) < 1 across beta in {289/500, 72/125, 23/40}. All 20 Lean 4.35.0 theorems verify with zero sorry, zero custom axioms, and zero Classical.choice, paired with an AST-audited zero-float verifier, 16 JSON certificates, and 61 unit and forgery-rejection tests.
